capabilities: Render charts from Markdown tables inside code blocks
Build charts from the properties of notes matching a tag or folder
Create custom colour palettes or fall back to theme colours
Edit chart options such as type, title, axes, stacking and height
Export rendered charts as vector images in PDF export
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation lives on an external site (abdulkader-safi.github.io/obsidian-s-chart-plugins); version 0.5.0 is the first public release.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Markdown table or note properties into a rendered chart inside a note.
summary: Chart plugin that draws bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, scatter, radar and heatmap charts from Markdown tables or note properties, in theme colours.
